# Lab 20.6: Cost Controls: Custom Quotas

## What We Are Going to Do
Set daily query limits for the project and for each user, and test the error you get when a limit is reached.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open the quotas.** **IAM & Admin → Quotas & system limits**. Filter **Service: BigQuery API**. Find:
   - **Query usage per day** (project)
   - **Query usage per day per user**

2. **[Console] Set a per-user limit.** Select **Query usage per day per user → Edit**. Set it to **1 TiB**. Save. Set the project-wide daily limit to **5 TiB**.

3. **[CLI] Check the quotas.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services quota list --service=bigquery.googleapis.com --consumer=projects/$PROJECT_ID \
  --filter="metric~query" 2&gt;/dev/null | head -40</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Test the limit (optional).** With a very small temporary limit (for example 10 GiB per user), run large queries until one fails with **Custom quota exceeded**. Then set the limit back.

5. **[CLI] Per-query limit.** Combine quotas with `maximum_bytes_billed` on important jobs:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --maximum_bytes_billed=1000000000 \
  'SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.samples.github_timeline`'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Project quota | Total on-demand bytes per day |
| User quota | Bytes per user per day |
| Error | `Custom quota exceeded` |
| Per query | `maximum_bytes_billed` |
